candidate_headquarters_coordinates_check.name: candidate_headquarters_coordinates_check
candidate_headquarters_coordinates_check.value: ("candidate_headquarters"."latitude_microdegrees" IS NULL AND "candidate_headquarters"."longitude_microdegrees" IS NULL) OR ("candidate_headquarters"."latitude_microdegrees" IS NOT NULL AND "candidate_headquarters"."longitude_microdegrees" IS NOT NULL)

candidate_relationships_target_check.name: candidate_relationships_target_check
candidate_relationships_target_check.value: ("candidate_relationships"."target_candidate_id" IS NOT NULL AND "candidate_relationships"."target_public_name" IS NULL) OR ("candidate_relationships"."target_candidate_id" IS NULL AND "candidate_relationships"."target_public_name" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("candidate_relationships"."target_public_name")) > 0)

discovery_runs_running_lease_check.name: discovery_runs_running_lease_check
discovery_runs_running_lease_check.value: "discovery_runs"."status" <> 'running' OR ("discovery_runs"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_runs"."lease_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL)

onboarding_drafts_identity_subtype_check.name: onboarding_drafts_identity_subtype_check
onboarding_drafts_identity_subtype_check.value:
(
        ("onboarding_drafts"."identity_kind" = 'organisation' AND "onboarding_drafts"."organisation_subtype" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_drafts"."creator_subtype" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("onboarding_drafts"."identity_kind" = 'creator' AND "onboarding_drafts"."creator_subtype" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_drafts"."organisation_subtype" IS NULL)
      )

profiles_identity_subtype_check.name: profiles_identity_subtype_check
profiles_identity_subtype_check.value:
(
        ("profiles"."identity_kind" = 'organisation' AND "profiles"."organisation_subtype" IS NOT NULL AND "profiles"."creator_subtype" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("profiles"."identity_kind" = 'creator' AND "profiles"."creator_subtype" IS NOT NULL AND "profiles"."organisation_subtype" IS NULL)
      )
